name: The Agency Landing Page

source.readFrom: Extracted from the Desktop design frame (no separate design-system page).

character: Bold, playful NEO-BRUTALIST agency style. Hard 2–3px black borders, chunky offset drop-shadows, bright multi-colour accents, extra-bold Montserrat display, pill 'badge' section titles, and hand-drawn doodle accents (squiggles, stars, blobs). Confident and fun, not corporate. Good reference for creative / agency / bold-brand leads.

typography.notes: One family, carried by weight (extra-bold 800 for all display, regular 400 for body). Hero words get a colour highlight (e.g. one word in yellow). No serif, no mono.

color.notes: Near-black navy ink #0b0f17 on white, with a warm YELLOW primary and a whole playful accent set (orange, salmon, green, purple) used on cards, bands and icon tiles. Full-width colour BANDS (orange, yellow) separate major sections. REUSE the structure and the black-border/shadow treatment; put the lead's own brand colour in the primary slot and pull the accent set toward it.

spacing.notes: Generous section padding (~125px). Cards are roomy (20–30px). Content on a ~1200px column in a 1440 frame.

components.signatureStyle: NEO-BRUTALIST: every card / button / badge / input has a solid 2–3px BLACK border and a hard offset drop-shadow (e.g. 4px 4px 0 #000), fully-squared or gently-rounded corners. No soft blurred shadows.

button.shape: Rounded rect with black border + offset shadow.
button.notes: Label only or label + arrow. Two side-by-side in the hero (white secondary + coloured primary).

card.shape: White, black border, offset shadow, rounded corners.
card.contents: Icon tile (coloured, rounded) → heading → short body; project cards add an image slot + circular arrow button.

badge.shape: Pill with black border used as a SECTION TITLE (e.g. 'Our Best Service', 'Latest Project' with sparkles).
badge.note: This replaces plain centered headings — a signature of this system.

pricingCard.shape: Coloured card (green / white-recommended / purple), black border, big price, feature bullets, dark 'Select Plan' button; 'Recommended' tag + starburst on the middle one.

sectionLayouts.note: Real top-to-bottom recipe. Reuse the archetypes + the neo-brutalist treatment; swap in the lead's brand + content.

order.layout: Floating pill nav bar (black border + shadow): logo left, nav links right. Doodle/blob accents behind.

Asymmetric. Left: huge extra-bold stacked heading (one word colour-highlighted) + short lead + two buttons (white secondary + coloured primary). Right: a big rounded image card with sparkle/star doodles around it.
Centered heading + a row of greyscale logo placeholders.
On a full-width COLOUR band. Pill badge title, then 3 white bordered cards, each: coloured icon tile → heading → description.
Pill badge title (with sparkles), then a 2-row × 3-col grid of project cards (image slot + title + blurb + circular arrow button).

On a full-width COLOUR band. Pill badge title, then 3 pricing cards (coloured), middle one 'Recommended' with a starburst; each: name, big price, billing note, feature bullets, dark Select-Plan button.
Huge centered heading (one word colour-highlighted) + a single coloured button. Doodle squiggles around.
Colour band: copyright left, circular bordered social icons right.

reusableArchetypes: floating pill nav bar with border+shadow
asymmetric hero with colour-highlighted word + doodle accents
pill 'badge' section titles instead of plain headings
3 bordered service cards with coloured icon tiles
2×3 project grid with circular arrow buttons
3-tier pricing with a highlighted middle card + starburst
craftNotes: Hard black borders + offset shadows on everything is the defining move — never soft/blurred shadows.
Hand-drawn doodles (squiggles, stars, blobs) float behind hero and CTA for playfulness.
Full-width colour bands (orange, yellow) give rhythm; the yellow primary highlights key words.

referenceImages.reference.png: The full desktop landing page showing the neo-brutalist system in use.

reuse: Great for creative/agency/bold-brand leads. Take the neo-brutalist card/button treatment (black border + offset shadow), pill badge titles, colour-band rhythm, extra-bold Montserrat scale, and the section archetypes. Put the lead's brand colour in the yellow/primary slot; keep the black-border treatment.
